data.description:
## Context
Audit authored code and configuration for comments or docstrings that obscure useful context through repetition, obvious narration, duplicated documentation, or excessive history. Preserve non-obvious invariants, safety constraints, compatibility contracts, citations, and surprising behavior.

## Plan
- Partition `src/`, `scripts/`, `tests/`, `infra/`, and `.github/` into small read-only audit shards.
- Validate reported findings and create one child task per affected file.
- Each child identifies the bloated locations, the information to preserve, and the intended concise form or better documentation home.
- Implement and land the child remediations independently.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every in-scope authored file is covered by a recorded audit shard.
- [ ] Every confirmed affected file has exactly one child task with precise file impact.
- [ ] Child tasks require preserving relevant rationale and contracts while removing comment bloat.
- [ ] All child remediations pass repository gates and land through Gerrit.
- [ ] The epic records audit coverage and the final child-ticket inventory.
data.title: Remediate bloated source comments
